title.zh: Russian Central Bank: Restrictions on Non-Custodial Wallets Do Not Apply to Cros
title.en: Russian Central Bank: Restrictions on Non-Custodial Wallets Do Not Apply to Cros

current_state.zh: The Bank of Russia said draft restrictions on non-custodial crypto wallets will not apply to cross-border settlements, while domestic direct investment through such wallets will remain disallowed for investor-protection and AML reasons.
current_state.en: The Bank of Russia said draft restrictions on non-custodial crypto wallets will not apply to cross-border settlements, while domestic direct investment through such wallets will remain disallowed for investor-protection and AML reasons.
